name: slapmod
description: Slap your MacBook and Claude feels it: a live motion meter, bonks, and slaps that stop Claude, run a command or send a prompt.

sensitivity.title: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: From 1, only a real smack counts, to 10, a tap on the desk counts. Tune it live in /slap settings.

onSlap.title: On slap
onSlap.description: stop: a slap stops Claude's turn and Claude hears why. tell: Claude hears about your slaps with your next message. command or prompt: runs the slap text below. off: sounds and meter only.

slapText.title: Slap text
slapText.description: The slash command (like /compact) or the prompt a slap runs, when On slap is command or prompt.

onDoubleSlap.title: On double slap
onDoubleSlap.description: What two quick slaps do. Same choices as On slap.

doubleSlapText.title: Double slap text
doubleSlapText.description: The slash command or the prompt a double slap runs, when On double slap is command or prompt.
doubleSlapText.default: That's not it. Step back and try a different approach.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: bonk: a cartoon bonk. whip: a whip crack. voice: your Mac's own voice yells one of five lines. off: silence.
